pro_course_detail.title: Learn new vocabulary, phrasal verbs and idioms and use them confidently in conversation!
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson we will focus on building your vocabulary and confidence to use new words, phrases and idioms naturally and in free flowing conversation. 
Sometimes because we can't prepare before speaking, it means that we only use language we are very comfortable with. Maybe your written English is a much higher level than your spoken English and you want to find a way to connect the two. 
In this lesson I will prepare vocabulary, phrasal verbs and idioms, tailored to your level, around a conversation topic. You will learn the new material and immediately practice using it through guided questions, giving you plenty of opportunity to start to feel natural and comfortable with the new material. This will then flow into more open conversation questions which will allow you to begin to use new material in a more spontaneous manner. 
Optional homework tasks include reading tasks to expand your vocabulary and writing tasks to practice using new material in sentences.
I always provide PDFs for you to have before and after the lesson, and I will always provide plenty of detail and context for new words and phrases and encourage you to use them like a native speaker!

2. No❌ grammar books and boring/long grammar explanations.  

3. Listen first! 

4. Listen - Answer - Repeat!

course_info.trial_description:
A chance for us to meet and get to know each other a little. 
I'd like to know what your English learning goals are, what you are interested in, and what you find most challenging about learning English. 
If you are looking for Business English, or English for work, I'd like to know what your job is, and any specific goals you have, e.g., email writing, presentations, legal English, etc. If you're looking for help to prepare for IELTS, I'd like to know what your primary motivation for taking IELTS is, when you're hoping to take it, and how familiar you are with the exam. If you're mainly interested in improving your conversational skills, I'd like to know what you like to read, to watch, to do - what feeds your soul!
No doubt, you also have some questions for me, which I will of course be happy to answer! 

We will also discuss how you'd like to be corrected and the timeframe you have in mind, as well as the types of materials which may be suitable and useful for us to work towards your unique goals - in my classes I often use current (high quality) newspaper articles, and I have subscriptions to several ESL lesson libraries. Sometimes I create bespoke lessons for a student's individual needs. My students are also welcome to bring their own materials - whether that is a report or presentation you need help with, or a passage from a book or a poem you found particularly interesting. 

I am a very patient, friendly and open person with a genuine passion for English, and a love of meeting people from other cultures. I will put you at ease if you are nervous, and do my very best to ensure you feel relaxed and comfortable, so you can make the most of our time together and achieve your personal aims. 

I look forward to meeting you!

pro_course_detail.title: Preparation for IELTS
pro_course_detail.description:
***This class is NOT for children under 16 years old***

Taking an IELTS exam can be lifechanging and daunting, in equal measure! 

In an IELTS preparation lesson we will practice the speaking and writing parts of the exam - parts 1, 2 and 3 of the Speaking test, and Tasks 1 and 2 of the Writing exam.

We will look at:
- what exactly you need to do in order to achieve the band score you require;
- useful exam tips to increase your understanding and confidence; and
- vocabulary, grammar and pronunciation 

We can practice under timed conditions if you wish, working towards a mock exam eventually. 

For IELTS lessons, I refer regularly to British Council materials (I attend monthly IELTS teachers' webinars run by the British Council) as well as various text books and several IELTS websites which provide useful resources. I will also provide you with multiple resources for independent practise, and an ongoing record of what we cover together. 

ALL my IELTS students have gone on to achieve the band score they wanted or higher!

pro_course_detail.title: British English for communication: general conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
***Please note this class is NOT for children. If you want to book classes for your child please choose my British English for Kids lesson***

I am an outgoing person - I love meeting people, and I am quite a chatterbox in my day-to-day life! In these lessons, we will choose a topic and chat at length about it. We can use newspaper articles, videos and social media to stimulate conversation, and of course, you are welcome (and I actively encourage you) to choose a subject which is particularly interesting to you. I will ask questions about your opinions and reasons, creating lots of opportunities for you to communicate and explain your personal ideas about all kinds of things, ranging in complexity. 

The aim of these lessons is to get you comfortable and confident with communicating (i.e., conveying meaning) in English more effectively, so I will provide feedback on pronunciation errors only when they affect the clarity of the meaning. Similarly, I will give you feedback on grammar if there are serious mistakes which make it difficult to understand. This approach allows more time and space for you to practice developing fluency. I usually make notes during class, so we can go over the details of any grammatical errors later, rather than interrupting your flow. 

I am a natural, strong communicator, and I find I can often instinctively understand what my students are trying to express, even when they struggle to find the right words. I will offer suggestions of alternative vocabulary, idioms or colloquial expressions that might be more commonly used in spoken English, which will help your communication feel and sound more natural. 

I am British, and these lessons will include everyday British idioms, sayings and expressions, and where relevant, my personal insights into and reflections on British culture. They will be useful for anyone who wants to communicate with British people in general, but particularly helpful for anyone immigrating to the UK.

pro_course_detail.title: Writing correction / proofreading
pro_course_detail.description:
I will provide comprehensive correction and feedback comments on a wide range of writing, including but not limited to: 
- university essays, dissertations, theses 
- IELTS Task 1 and Task 2 essays, both general and academic
- work emails, reports, presentations
- CVs, job applications
- online content - websites, LinkedIn profile, social media / video captions

THIS CLASS IS OFFLINE AND DOES NOT REQUIRE PHYSICAL ATTENDANCE
To book this service, please book the class then contact me to email the documents. 
As I have a busy schedule, please ensure you allow A MINIMUM of 48 hours to correct your work. 

You will receive:
An edited document showing any spelling mistakes, grammar mistakes and typos;
Changes and suggestions to improve clarity, coherence and cohesion, structure and readability;
Tracked revisions so you can see and review all the changes/suggestions that have been made; 
Formatting suggestions, if applicable; and
A brief analysis of how well your writing achieves the requirements set out in the Public Band Descriptors for IELTS, if applicable. 
**Please note that it is NOT allowed for teachers who are not accredited IELTS examiners to give band score predictions, therefore I cannot give you a band score**

PLEASE CHECK THE WORD COUNT OF YOUR DOCUMENT(S) BEFORE BOOKING. 
Time estimates are approximate and depend on the original quality of writing:
Up to 500 words - 30 Minutes
500 - 1000 words - 1 hour
1000 - 2000 words - 1.5 hours 
Please contact me for anything over 2,000 words so I can assess the difficulty and time required - I will set a bespoke lesson price for you.
